topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: It’s a hard thing, to find out your neighbor's been telling tales about what he does. I’ve always thought honest work, no matter how small, is what sets a man’s worth. But now I see his boastful words on market days, saying how he sells this and that. All this time, it was just stories. I don’t know what to say to him no more. The soil doesn’t lie; it gives what it’s given. Maybe that’s what separates the earth from us. I’ll stick to my plow and let the saints sort the rest.
